name: execute-escalation
description: Substrate outbox handler for capability support.escalate_to_human. Verifies HMAC, dedupes via idempotency.claim, fans out to every active escalation_target (or one if target_config_id provided), sends each via Composio Slack/Gmail. Writes one escalations row per target (idempotency_key = action_id:target_id) and one activity per outcome. ok=true if any target succeeded.
